question: _____ was the residence of the Mughal emperors of India for nearly 200 years until 1857.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red Fort.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Red Fort** was the main residence of the emperors in the Mughal dynasty for nearly 200 years.
 
• The Red Fort of Agra was founded by Akbar.
 
• Red Fort at Delhi was built by **Shah Jahan.**
